piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over Avenue Ground (0 m) — Diagonal Crossing 90°.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over Avenue Ground (0 m) — Diagonal Crossing 90°
piece.description: Five coordinated construction tiles preserve the native stacked DD RHW-4 lanes above both directions of a diagonal avenue, including avenue pedestrians. This crossing supplies through routes; connecting access ramps are separate components.

provenance.geometry: Independently measured native NAM DD RHW-4 and Avenue channels.
provenance.construction: Explicit five-cell RUL0 construction; measured native network flags; four proper rotations repeated.
